metadata.title: Provisional PFC nanodroplet laser-cavitation-transfer reference case

evidence_labels.V: verified project artifact or numerical result
evidence_labels.S: project scenario assumption inherited from Stage 1
evidence_labels.E: explicit engineering estimate used only for screening

metadata.critical_warning: This file is a reproducible calculation contract, not a calibrated material card or an operator-safe laser prescription. Replace every M or E item before physical prediction. External source pressure is not cohesive traction, and single-cycle impulse must not be multiplied by pulse count without cycle-resolved R(t).

wavelength_m.source: Stage 1 parameter ledger; actual hardware value required

peak_fluence_J_m2.source: Stage 1 parameter ledger; 0.10 J/cm2 reference and 0.01-1 J/cm2 computational screen

initial_temperature_K.source: ambient-temperature screening estimate; measure at specimen

activation.model_status: unidentified stochastic heterogeneous-nucleation model; no hard threshold is authorized

F50_J_m2.source: incident-fluence-only design prior retained for backward comparison; any fit is conditional on beam, formulation, active volume, batch, and detector and is not a material property

log_fluence_slope.source: design-only prior for the conditional incident-fluence submodel; replace with a multivariable fit

local_absorbed_dose_D50_J_m3.source: fit from target-specific activation trials after source-normalization and local-dose reconstruction

peak_absorbed_power_density_Q50_W_m3.source: fit jointly with absorbed dose and pulse duration; fluence alone is insufficient

active_droplet_number_density_m3.source: measure for each formulation/batch; required to convert population to single-droplet probability

active_fraction.source: measure or infer by batch; absorber-bearing/activation-capable fraction is formulation dependent

detector_event_sensitivity.source: calibrate against an independent event count; PA/US contrast is not pressure

detector_false_positive_probability.source: estimate from sham trials for the declared detector and event rule

low_energy_branch_probability.source: fit conditional no-event/low-energy/high-energy branch probabilities near onset

high_energy_branch_probability.source: fit conditional no-event/low-energy/high-energy branch probabilities; do not average branch mechanics

legacy_ODV_minimum_fluence_J_m2.source: Strohm et al., Biomedical Optics Express 2 (2011), DOI 10.1364/BOE.2.001432; PbS-loaded micron PFC droplets, not transferable as target threshold

density_kg_m3.source: water-like carrier estimate near 20 C; measure formulated suspension

dynamic_viscosity_Pa_s.source: water-like carrier estimate; measure formulated suspension

surface_tension_N_m.source: water-like estimate; surfactant/shell can reduce it, so measure

sound_speed_m_s.source: water-like estimate; measure or justify for formulation

equilibrium_vapor_pressure_Pa.source: water-vapor estimate over approximately 15-30 C; effective bubble vapor/gas pressure must be inferred

ambient_pressure_Pa.source: laboratory atmospheric-pressure estimate; record during test

illustrative_PFH_core.identity_warning: The project PFC core is unknown. These perfluoro-n-hexane values are an illustrative energy bound, not a target material assignment.

droplet_radius_m.source: screening radius; replace with batch DLS/microscopy distribution

liquid_density_kg_m3.source: perfluorohexane density near 25 C compiled in PubChem/CRC; target identity unconfirmed

liquid_heat_capacity_J_kgK.source: NIST liquid Cp 57.41 cal/mol/K at 273 K converted using molar mass; extrapolation uncertainty exposed

latent_heat_J_kg.source: NIST vaporization enthalpy 31.5 kJ/mol at 316 K converted using molar mass

maximum_radius_m.source: Stage 1 scenario; replace with measured R(t)

growth_time_s.source: Stage 1 scenario; replace with measured R(t)

collapse_time_s.source: Stage 1 scenario value; range is a calculation-only screen

residual_radius_m.source: regularized post-collapse radius; not a physical rebound model

boundary_pressure_gain.source: unbounded monopole baseline; sweep brackets pressure-release/rigid-image effects but is not a wall model

minimum_bubble_to_stack_clearance_m.source: Stage 1 native 3D setup; must stay positive for ALE

stand_off_ratio_gamma.source: defined as bubble-centroid distance divided by Rmax; reference value follows Rmax plus 0.5 um clearance

pressure_load_radius_m.source: set equal to optical 1/e2 radius for initial screen

clamped_patch_radius_m.source: screening support radius; replace with device geometry

density_kg_m3.source: generic PVC screening estimate; replace by certificate/measurement

young_modulus_Pa.source: broad flexible-to-rigid PVC screening range; rate/temperature data required

acoustic_amplitude_attenuation_Np_m.source: lossless first-arrival baseline and explicit sensitivity bracket only; measure frequency-dependent target attenuation

density_kg_m3.source: generic polymer-film screening estimate; identify actual film

acoustic_amplitude_attenuation_Np_m.source: lossless first-arrival baseline and explicit sensitivity bracket only; measure frequency-dependent target attenuation

modal_damping_ratio.source: screening estimate; identify from dynamic test

mode_I_fracture_energy_J_m2.source: screening range only; peel/blister/mixed-mode coupons are blocking

normal_strength_Pa.source: screening range only; cohesive strength measurement is blocking

cohesive_process_zone_target_elements.source: initial convergence target informed by cohesive-zone practice; verify numerically

terminal_substrate_acoustic_impedance_Ra.source: identify the material below the transfer film and measure or justify its longitudinal impedance before computing reflected tensile/interface stress

stress_wave.longitudinal_speed_closure: isotropic elastic cL=sqrt(E(1-nu)/(rho(1+nu)(1-2nu))); illustrative until rate-dependent dynamic properties are measured

quasistatic_minimum_load_time_over_one_w.source: conservative escalation flag, not a universal physical boundary

reflection_amplitude_escalation.source: model-escalation flag for material impedance mismatch

attenuation_exponent_escalation.source: model-escalation flag for alpha*h; target attenuation is unmeasured

stress_wave.terminal_interface_warning: Without the terminal substrate impedance and a signed transient solution, first-arrival forward compressive stress is not cohesive normal traction; tangential shear and through-thickness stress are also unresolved.

initial_active_droplet_count.source: number of activation-capable droplets in the local active volume at pulse 1

per_pulse_survival_probability.source: formulation-, dose-, and detector-conditioned; fit from repeated-shot data

recondensation_probability_before_next_p.source: depends on core, shell, temperature, pressure, environment, and observer ultrasound

pulse_history.warning: Do not sum a single-cycle impulse over pulse count unless cycle-to-cycle R(t), source position, phase, and survivor state are measured or validated.

transferred_material.warning: Rayleigh-Plateau, jet Weber, and liquid-breakup-length criteria are disabled for the solid-patch branch; use fracture/folding/rotation/contact gates instead.

time_points.source: resolves the regularized 1.3 us bubble cycle
